rationale.hitl-workflow: Mandatory expert gates enable rejection and rollback of AI proposals.
rationale.rules-based-checks: SAST, container scanning, validation scripts, and deployment gates inspect outputs.
rationale.ai-review: LLM audits legacy code for secrets and environment leakage.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: AI-generated IAM configurations violated least-privilege security requirements.
rationale.quality-debt: Case study measures complexity, runtime anomalies, and maintainability improvements.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: PCI-DSS compliance directly constrains generation, validation, networking, and deployment.
rationale.framework: Reusable four-pillar, five-stage migration workflow integrates with enterprise pipelines.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and evaluated the cloud-native payment architecture.
rationale.adopted: Modernized system operated in production with operational logs and telemetry.
rationale.assistive: Human-directed module work produced incrementally reviewed proposals and logic blocks.
rationale.steering: Constraint templates and standardized prompts substantively shape generated implementations.
rationale.counterpoint: Argues against autonomous development for mission-critical financial migrations.
rationale.risk-security: Evaluates security hardening, least privilege, secret removal, and vulnerability scanning.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports measured complexity, latency, reliability, and maintainability outcomes.
rationale.method-mining: Production logs, issue records, and workflow telemetry provide empirical evidence.
rationale.method-field-study: Industrial migration was observed during real enterprise engineering work.
